• Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, announced on his website that he believes he has proved the Riemann hypothesis using the large language model Claude.
• The claim has not been independently verified and Anthropic has not commented on the result.

• Meta announced the Muse Charm wearable will cost $300 and ship before December holidays.
• It uses a fingerprint sensor to activate AI without unlocking a phone, plus a free 12-month 5G plan.
• AI wearables have struggled to gain mass adoption, as seen with the Humane AI Pin.
